data.name: Tear Them All
data.detailed_description:
Tear Them All is a stylized arena shooter game set in a chaotic notebook realm. You're trapped in this realm and the only thing you can do is to survive through endless waves of doodle enemies with your pencil weapon.

Tear, Rip and Split

To survive you need to tear, rip and split those doodle enemies. Use your pencil to shred through the chaos before they erase you from existence.

Keep It Sharp

Your pencil gets duller and weaker the more you use it. To stay alive, you have to balance between shooting from long range and meleeing at close range. Enemies are stunned when their health is low, but you need to be quick to finish them with your "tear" finisher, or you'll lose that bonus score.

Break Your Highscore

Every doodle you destroy adds to your score. Chain your kills, keep the momentum alive and shred through entire waves to push your score higher.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a graphics card with Vulkan 1.1 support.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1/M2) or Intel Core i5
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Metal support
